allowed_claim: Disabled provider-free v3 fixed-chain validator and denial surface locally close the v2 chronology/authority/schema findings; authentic artifacts, independent rereview, and final block authority remain absent.

chronology.authority: No duck-typed or caller-supplied authority/store/root/review digest. Public authorize_opening accepts zero arguments, imports the exact file-identity-pinned human validator, calls its no-argument fixed-root API, and accepts only exact fixed artifact pins.
boundary_order: fixed independently reviewed human registry and G1/G2 grants
fixed independently reviewed final block grant binding exact commitment
four no-replace attempt receipts binding grant review plus commitment plus request/result refs
four evaluation packet records binding exact attempt receipts
human grade records binding exact packet records and fixed human grant/review refs
final manifest binding the whole exact sequence
chronology.immutability: Fixed owner-root 0700; nested directories 0700; all chain files regular owner-owned 0600; dirfd/O_NOFOLLOW reads; exact path/bytes/SHA/mode pins; canonical JSON; no-replace refs and monotone sequences.
chronology.private_map_boundary: Receipt and commitment may be read first; the private map is read only after authentic human validation, complete fixed pins, exact chronology cross-field validation, and exact external request/result/evaluation/grade/metric artifact rereads.

schema_contract: Eleven closed Draft 2020-12 schemas encode nonempty IDs, exact cell enums, exact path enums, exact array cardinalities and uniqueness, nested additionalProperties=false, and fixed commitment receipt paths. Runtime validators additionally enforce exact canonical ref bytes/SHA, cross-field identity, chronology, G3 cardinality, and manifest closure.
